title: Beyond Binary Labels: Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Safety with Prompt-Level Rubrics
abstract: arXiv:2610.29225v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current LLM safety benchmarks predominantly rely on binary safe or unsafe labels, lacking explanatory depth and suffering from low consistency across automated judges. To address this, we introduce DiagSafe, a diagnostic evaluation framework that moves beyond binary classification by employing prompt-level rubrics. Grounded in globally applicable AI safety policies, each rubric provides explicit criteria along two dimensions: safety, which targets concrete harms with specific exemptions to suppress false positives, and usefulness, which independently evaluates instruction fulfillment. translated_title: 超越二元标签：基于提示级评分细则的大语言模型安全性诊断评估
translated_abstract: 当前的大语言模型（LLM）安全基准主要依赖“安全”或“不安全”的二元标签，缺乏解释深度，且不同自动化评判器之间的一致性较低。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DiagSafe，一个超越二元分类、采用提示级评分细则的诊断评估框架。该框架以全球适用的AI安全政策为基础，每个评分细则沿两个维度提供明确的评判标准：安全性维度针对具体危害，并设置特定豁免条款以抑制误报；有用性维度则独立评估指令的完成程度。为确保评估的稳健性和现实性，我们构建了一个基于全面84类安全分类体系的双语（英文-中文）基准，包含两个子集：DiagBase，涵盖单轮和多轮提示中的直接有害查询以及基于模板的越狱攻击；DiagAttack，将有害意图嵌入复杂指令之中（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出DiagSafe诊断评估框架，以基于全球AI安全政策的提示级评分细则取代传统二元安全标签，从安全性与有用性两个独立维度对大语言模型进行更细致、更具解释性的双语安全评估。
en_tdlr: We propose DiagSafe, a diagnostic evaluation framework that replaces binary safety labels with prompt-level rubrics grounded in global AI safety policies, enabling more nuanced and explanatory bilingual LLM safety evaluation across independent safety and usefulness dimensions.
